metaDescription: Tobi's Harbor by HeyOggi Games: support and privacy policy.
translationNote: This is a translation. If it differs from the English version, the English version applies.
intro: Help Tobi bring a sleepy seaside harbor back to life by sorting cargo, clearing shelves and restoring the docks. A cozy puzzle game you can play in a few minutes a day, also offline.
supportP: Questions, bug reports or ideas? E-mail us at {email}. Please include your device model and the game version ({settings} → bottom of the screen). We usually reply within 2 business days.
a1: Only on your device. The game has no account and no cloud save, so uninstalling it deletes your progress (on Android, a copy may come back from your Google system backup if it is turned on).
q2: How do I start the game over?
a2: {settings} → {resetProgress}. The game asks you to confirm first. Your sound, language and data-sharing settings are kept.
q3: How do I stop sharing play statistics or delete them?
a3: {settings} → turn off {dataSharing}; from then on no statistics are sent. {settings} → {deleteData} asks Unity Analytics to delete the anonymous statistics linked to your game; this is usually completed within 30 days. See the {privacyLink} for details.
delIntro: Tobi's Harbor has no accounts and no sign-up: we never ask for your name or e-mail. The only data that leaves your phone is anonymous play statistics, and only if you agreed to share them. Here is how to delete everything.
delStats1: Open Tobi's Harbor and go to {settings}.
delStats2: Tap {deleteData}. The game asks Unity Analytics to delete all statistics linked to your game's random install id and turns {dataSharing} off. Unity usually completes the deletion within 30 days.
delStopP: To only stop sending statistics, turn off {dataSharing} in {settings}.
delLocalP: Your progress is stored only on your device. {settings} → {resetProgress} deletes it and starts the game over. Uninstalling the game also deletes it (on Android, a copy may remain in your Google system backup if it is turned on).
delNoAppH: If you no longer have the game
delNoAppP: Without the game we cannot tell which statistics are yours, because they carry only a random install id and no name, e-mail or device identifier. They are deleted automatically when Unity's retention period ends (raw events after at most 1 year). Questions: {email}.
